decisions.reason: Moving the I2C pull-ups to the Main Board does not change the battery connector's required NTC contact.
The I2C pull-up relocation does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection behavior on the Power Board.
Relocating I2C pull-ups between existing boards leaves the established three-board architecture unchanged.
I2C pull-ups are unrelated to the MT3608 enable pull-down and software-switched 5V sensor rail.
